Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de piese pentru autovehicule
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Senior RPA Developer.
 The Senior RPA Developer will be responsible with development of complex and professional automation processes in our organization. This role involves background study, analyzing, developing, testing and deploying solutions to meet business requirements.
 Should you be interested in overseeing these tasks and aiming for enhanced performance standards, your role will involve:
Analyze current processes together with process owners, determine which are feasible for automation, create As-Is process map together with process owner, document the process steps in Autoliv’s PDD template, develop the RPA process end-to-end, create technical maps, technical documentations, deliver PDD as per expectations set by Autoliv.
Support existing RPA Implementations and demands
Development and delivery of automation solutions as per the project schedule and timeline
Support current RPA Infrastructure, suggest improvements, support future implementations
Program governance and status reporting
Develop automation solutions according to industry best practices & follow Autoliv’s best practices
Suggest improvements regarding current infrastructure, development environment, current methodology, project management tool, etc
Expand technical expertise in complementary automation platforms (Power Automate, Rossum) and recommend their use where applicable
 If You Have/are
At least 3-5 years hands-on experience with UiPath
At least 1 year experience in programming, web design
Senior level knowledge of RPA Development, best practices, up to date industry standards
Interest and willingness to learn and work with additional automation technologies beyond UiPath
Client facing experience
Experience with other automation tools is a plus
Experience in software development is a plus
Minimum 3 years hands-on experience with Uipath
Experience with .Net, Python, C++ or similar programming language
At least basic experience in web design
At least basic experience in network protocols
Good English on business level
Analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and ownership
Minimum 3–5 years in RPA development
 We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
 In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
 More lives saved – more life lived!
